scope: offline long-only research only; no live inference, exchange, admission, portfolio, or execution mutation
purpose: Extend the frozen F72/router causal input history so the requested four-month meta and six-month MC1 evaluation can be run without substituting in-sample or post-date scores.

contract.candidate_source_rule: the two adjacent signal-month identity ledgers are sliced by exact decision timestamp so first-hour boundary candidates are retained; all identity rows are retained, including invalid and unresolved labels; no target, path, policy, or outcome column enters the generated output
contract.features: ordered union of immutable F72 B 72-field and immutable full-universe router 30-field contracts, plus causal generation dependencies
contract.feature_generation: canonical hourly causal engine over a 90-day trailing context; no minute fallback
contract.downstream: router and F72 scoring retain independent strict label-availability, reserve, and OOF gates

validation.output_identity_requirement: candidate identity set must equal the input identity ledger per month
